title: The bits remember matched prefixes
hook: One state mask can keep several overlapping match candidates alive.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Track all currently matched pattern prefixes with a shifted state mask AND a character mask.

misconception: A bit-parallel string matcher stores only one current candidate position.
objective: Track all currently matched pattern prefixes with a shifted state mask AND a character mask.

claims.text: A set state bit represents a currently matched prefix length. Shifting advances every active prefix while OR with one starts a new candidate; the character mask keeps only compatible prefixes. Multiple candidates survive together, so overlapping matches are retained.
